solution.p: Point A is 2 to the right and 4 down from the origin, so its coordinates are {\left(2,-4\right)}\text{.}
Point B is 3 to the right and 0 up from the origin, so its coordinates are {\left(3,0\right)}\text{.}
Point C is 0 to the right and 2 down from the origin, so its coordinates are {\left(0,-2\right)}\text{.}
Point D is 1 to the left and 3 down from the origin, so its coordinates are {\left(-1,-3\right)}\text{.}
